items.title: Restrict dev-mode CORS on config/API endpoints
acceptance: OPTIONS from http://evil.com does not return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Allowed dev origins are the explicit Vite origins only
Dev-mode startup logs a warning listing exposed origins
items.verify: cargo test -p wisphive_web && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
items.user_visible_change: Web dev mode no longer exposes API/config CORS broadly; only the configured Vite dev origins are allowed.
items.notes: CORS layer now uses an explicit origin list and dev startup logs the exposed origins.

items.title: Fail closed for exploitable hook error paths
acceptance: With mode=active and fail-mode=closed, daemon-unreachable errors deny
stdin larger than 8 MiB denies
parse, connect, timeout, and unexpected daemon message errors are covered by tests
items.verify: cargo test -p wisphive_hook && cargo clippy -p wisphive_hook -- -D warnings && cargo build -p wisphive_hook
items.user_visible_change: Active hook mode now defaults runtime failures to deny through ~/.wisphive/fail-mode=closed unless explicitly set open.
items.notes: AGENTS.md was updated because the runtime file and fail-open/fail-closed default changed.

items.title: Prove dashboard markdown rendering is XSS-safe and add CSP
acceptance: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML remains in the frontend
script/img-onerror/javascript href payloads render inertly
CSP blocks inline scripts
items.verify: cd crates/wisphive_web/frontend && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
items.user_visible_change: Hostile markdown-like agent text is covered by tests and the SPA has a CSP meta policy.
items.notes: MarkdownText already rendered as React nodes; this campaign added regression coverage and CSP.

items.title: Password-gate device revoke and rate-limit mass revoke
acceptance: Device revoke requires fresh password re-proof
Repeated revoke attempts are rate-limited
Gated reject events are audit logged
items.verify: cargo test -p wisphive_web && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
items.user_visible_change: A stolen web bearer token cannot revoke active peer devices without the account password; burst revokes return 429.
items.notes: Implemented as fresh web-password re-proof in the web handler, with audit rows for denied gated attempts.

items.title: Validate and atomically persist PUT /api/config
acceptance: Unknown fields are rejected or stripped
Oversized bodies return 413
config.json is atomically replaced and mode 0600
items.verify: cargo test -p wisphive_web && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
items.user_visible_change: Config writes are schema checked, body-limited, atomic, chmod 0600, and audit logged.
items.notes: PUT /api/config now rejects unknown keys and invalid value types before writing.

items.title: Confirm GET /api/config requires bearer auth
acceptance: GET /api/config without bearer returns 401
items.verify: cargo test -p wisphive_web api_config_rejects_missing_bearer && cargo test --workspace
items.user_visible_change: Existing bearer-token enforcement for /api/config is pinned by test evidence.
items.notes: No behavior change was needed; the existing security middleware already covered this route.

items.title: Return 404 when revoking an unknown web device
acceptance: POST /api/devices/{unknown-id}/revoke returns 404 and writes no audit row
Re-revoking an already-revoked id remains 200
items.verify: cargo test -p wisphive_web && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
items.user_visible_change: Unknown device revoke requests now return 404 without polluting web_audit; repeated revokes stay idempotent.
items.notes: Existence is checked before mutation so already-revoked and nonexistent IDs are distinguishable.

items.title: Resolve cargo-deny advisories and duplicate dependency warnings
acceptance: cargo deny check advisories bans sources exits zero
Unmaintained advisories for instant, paste, rustls-pemfile, and serial are resolved or explicitly policy-reviewed
items.verify: cargo deny check advisories bans sources
items.notes: Deferred because it is dependency-policy work outside the endpoint/hook/frontend fixes completed in this campaign.
